name: pokemon-moves-learn-method-full-multiplex
description: Multiplex move learnset hypergraph with PokéAPI Pokémon entries as nodes and all learn methods present in PokéAPI as layers. In each layer, a hyperedge corresponds to one move and contains the Pokémon that can learn it by that method.

hypergraph_metadata.name: (STRING) Dataset name (e.g., pokemon-moves-learn-method-full-multiplex).
hypergraph_metadata.weighted: (BOOL) Whether the hypergraph is weighted (e.g., false).
hypergraph_metadata.layer_type: (STRING) Semantic type of multiplex layers (e.g., learn_method).

nodes_metadata.name: (STRING) Pokémon name (e.g., pikachu).
nodes_metadata.generation: (STRING) Generation where the Pokémon species was introduced (e.g., generation-i).
nodes_metadata.is_default: (BOOL) Whether this is the default Pokémon form (e.g., true).
nodes_metadata.secondary_type: (STRING) Secondary Pokémon type when present (e.g., flying).

edges_metadata.move_ids: (list of INTs) PokéAPI move identifiers represented by the hyperedge (e.g., [85]).
edges_metadata.move_names: (list of STRINGs) Move names represented by the hyperedge (e.g., [thunderbolt]).
edges_metadata.move_types: (list of STRINGs) Move types represented by the hyperedge (e.g., [electric]).
edges_metadata.damage_classes: (list of STRINGs) Damage classes represented by the hyperedge (e.g., [special]).
edges_metadata.generations: (list of STRINGs) Move introduction generations represented by the hyperedge (e.g., [generation-i]).
edges_metadata.version_groups: (list of STRINGs) Version groups in which the incidence appears (e.g., [red-blue]).
edges_metadata.learn_methods: (list of STRINGs) Learn methods represented by the incidence (e.g., [level-up]).
edges_metadata.min_level: (INT) Minimum nonzero level at which a move is learned, when available (e.g., 15).
edges_metadata.n_observations: (INT) Number of raw PokéAPI learnset observations aggregated into the hyperedge (e.g., 42).
